en: The image shows a vintage building labeled 'La Gare' (the station) with the word 'MINIÉH' above it. The architecture is early 20th-century style, with large arched windows and a symmetrical facade. There are several trees in front of the building and a street with rocks or construction debris. People are visible near the entrance. The card is colorized and has a postal stamp in Greek and French, dated December 1909.
